transfer.stem: Which report preserves both the model limits and the observation limits?
transfer.passage:
NEW TRANSCRIPT PRACTICE — AUDIO PENDING
Teacher: These toy vehicles help our class discuss movement along a road. Their spacing does not represent real distances. State what this desk model leaves out.
Mina: I saw a bright object move above the harbour. Was it a plane?
Guide: Perhaps, but that short observation does not establish its identity. First note the time and direction. Then check a reliable guide for the sky at that time. Keep what you saw separate from what you think the object was.
No actual time, direction, real distance or object identity is supplied. Approved audio pending.
